name: Preordained
overview: Scripture reveals that God's sovereign plan is preordained according to His determinate counsel and foreknowledge, as seen in the crucifixion of Christ (Acts 2:23). Believers are predestined to be conformed to the image of Christ, highlighting God's purposeful election not based on human works but on His calling (Romans 8:29; 9:11). The imagery of the potter and clay illustrates God's authority to shape individuals for His purposes, demonstrating His mercy and justice in the distribution of honor and wrath (Romans 9:16, 21-22). This doctrine affirms God's ultimate control and intentionality in salvation and judgment.
